Qiao Qingshan, who knew all his family’s identities, said nothing—he just kept fiddling with his phone.

“Due to the recent outbreak of fake person incidents, we interrupt this program to bring you an emergency notice from the Special Operations Bureau.”

Zhong Yi simply smiled politely and didn’t respond. He was no stranger to her; they had once been lovers. They say the fourth son of the Zhou family is cold and a man of few words, but outsiders never saw how he looked when he spoke words of love.
After being dumped, Zhou Shiyi couldn’t let go of her and still loved her. The elders from both families rushed to set the wedding date, and due to the tight schedule, many of the things he wanted to give her couldn’t be custom-made in time.
After the wedding, he told his mother, “I’ll give her another one.” He wanted her to have everything that others had.
During their honeymoon, Zhong Yi saw a message he had left for her:
My darling, happy wedding.
No matter when, no matter what kind of person you are, I love you.

124118.synopsis:
My fiancé and my biological brother have hated me for ten years.
